lede: Syracuse carries the stronger underlying team rating — +2.8 against +0.1, a 2.7-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it UConn -12.2 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with UConn winning 79% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is continuity, where Syracuse leads UConn by 81 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 82% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
